description: This file defines the MailerSubscriber class, an event subscriber in the OrangeHRM system that listens for termination events and triggers email sending via an EmailQueueService when specific cache conditions are met.

classes.name: MailerSubscriber
classes.description: Event subscriber that triggers email dispatch at system termination based on cache conditions.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns the list of events to which this subscriber listens, specifically the kernel terminate event.

methods.name: onTerminateEvent
methods.description: Handles the termination event, checks cache, and sends emails if conditions are met, while logging execution details.
